chunks: Do you not believe in the Day of judgement, or do you not fear the exaction of account?

key_terms.الْحِسَابِ: The reckoning or accounting of deeds
key_terms.الْمَعَادِ: The afterlife or the place of return (Day of Judgement)
key_terms.نِقَاشَ: Exaction, detailed scrutiny, or strict accounting

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali ask his officers regarding their belief in the afterlife and the Day of Reckoning?
ai.summary: In this concise admonition from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) challenges an officer’s spiritual complacency by linking belief in the Resurrection (*al-Ma'ad*) with the tangible fear of detailed divine accounting (*hisab*). This reflects the Shia emphasis on *muhasaba* (self-reckoning) as a prerequisite for just governance, reminding the leader that administrative authority is subordinate to ultimate accountability before God.
